observations: Vercel MCP deploy_to_vercel remains advertised but server returns Tool not found.
Vercel MCP get_deployment_build_logs remains advertised but server returns Tool not found.
Vercel MCP get_project has a server-side schema mismatch and is unusable for deeper project inspection.
Normal-chat browser automation does not inherit the authenticated Work browser session and redirects to Vercel login.
GitHub Actions runs on Build-Colony fail before any step starts; jobs expose steps=null/logs_url=null, so a one-shot Vercel OAuth workflow cannot execute there.
Local container/runtime cannot resolve api.vercel.com/vercel.com/npm registry, so Vercel CLI or direct REST OAuth cannot be executed from this runtime.
conclusion: No additional software repair or replan is justified. The remaining blocker is exclusively the authenticated Work-browser deployment/execution surface.
